t: Magnusson 40-piece tool kit contains a robust collection of hand tools suitable for a wide range of repair and assembly jobs. The comprehensive tool set includes various screwdrivers, including VDE screwdrivers for electrical work, long nose pliers, and diagonal cutters. Also supplied are an adjustable wrench, folding metric hex keys, and a 5m tape measure. For general building and carpentry tasks, a junior hacksaw, 16oz claw hammer, and a magnetic torpedo level are included. All 40 pieces are efficiently stored in a Magnusson soft storage bag, making it a practical choice for everyday household repairs or site work.
b: Versatile Screwdriver Selection Including VDE Types
Pliers, Cutters & Adjustable Wrench for Grip & Fastening
Magnetic Torpedo Level for Accurate Measurement
